description: READ-ONLY GUIDANCE TOOL - USDT0 (LayerZero OFT) bridge history via MCP is not yet wired in this release. It requires owner-sig auth which is dashboard-bound until session-binding lands (same follow-up as live q402_oft_send). Returns a dashboard pointer and intentionally reports implemented:false so an LLM does not read the prose as an empty result. Future shape (finalized): most-recent-first list of up to 50 OFT bridges with guid, source/destination chains, USDT0 amount, native fee paid, and a LayerZero Scan link. For USDC/CCIP use q402_bridge_history.

ownerAddress.description: Owner EOA (0x address, optional - defaults to configured wallet).
